H9001: Verbal vav: joined to verb with no intervening prefix (usually conversive)  (future<->past)
H9002: Conjunctive vav -  i.e. followed by prefix, suffix or non-verb (conjunctive) (‘and/but’)
H9008: Prefix hé interrogative: at the start of a question
H9009: Prefix hé article: "the" for a subject, not object
H9010: Suffix aleph: definite article "the" in Aramaic
H9017: Punctuation Pe paragraph: ends a literary section
H9018: Punctuation Sameq paragraph: ends a lectionary section
H9019: Punctuation Inverted Nun paragraph: ends a lectionary section
